result.solution:
1) 计数器被 A 与 clockintr 并发读改写，需 tickslock 串行化。交错来源：多处理器并行、线程切换、中断处理程序与可被中断代码同时修改。
2) A 持锁且中断开启，本 CPU 递交时钟中断，clockintr 再取同一锁而自旋等待；A 被中断打断无法继续，故锁不会被释放，本 CPU 死锁/停滞。其他 CPU 若也需该锁会自旋等待，波及系统。
3) 约束：会被中断处理程序使用的锁，持锁期间本 CPU 必须关中断。acquire 先关中断再置 locked；release 先释放锁再恢复中断。颠倒则关中断前或释放后开中断前存在窗口，中断可插入并请求同一锁。
4) push_off/pop_off 记录本 CPU 持锁层数，仅层数归零才恢复到最外层进入前的中断使能状态；每次释放都开中断会破坏外层临界区。
5) S：A 成立，本 CPU 中断处理程序等待线程释放锁会死锁；B 不适用/不成立，因无另一 CPU。P：A 成立，本 CPU 中断等待本 CPU 线程仍可死锁；B 成立，另一 CPU 中断可等待线程释放锁，但线程可在其他 CPU 运行并释放，故不一定死锁。
6) 不能替代。禁止同 CPU 重复取锁只防自等待，不防本 CPU 中断在持锁期间打断并请求同一锁；持锁关中断才阻止该中断递交。

evidence.quote: Some xv6 spinlocks protect data that is used by both threads and interrupt handlers.
clockintr would try to acquire tickslock, see it was held, and wait for it to be released.
To avoid this situation, if a spinlock is used by an interrupt handler, a CPU must never hold that lock with interrupts enabled.
Interrupts may still occur on other CPUs, so an interrupt’s acquire can wait for a thread to release a spinlock; just not on the same CPU.
It is important that acquire call push_off strictly before setting lk->locked.
When that count reaches zero, pop_off restores the interrupt enable state that existed at the start of the outermost critical section.
The word concurrency refers to situations in which multiple instruction streams are interleaved, due to multiprocessor parallelism, thread switching, or interrupts.
Xv6 takes this latter view, and forbids a CPU that currently holds a lock from re-acquiring it.
